DE.background: union of all edgeR-tested genes in constituent axis studies with an unambiguous human-symbol mapping

IG.sets: existing overall and species consensus Top 100; conserved is human/mouse Top-100 intersection

theme_rules.regex: muscle system process|muscle contraction|striated muscle contraction
cytoskeleton in muscle|muscle structure|muscle organ development|muscle tissue development|striated muscle tissue development|myofibril|actomyosin|sarcomere

blank_cells: no significant corrected source term mapped to theme

study_descriptions.Pattern A:
Human GSE108643/GSE86931: vastus lateralis cycling (immediate at 50% VO₂max/650 kcal; 4 h after 70 min at 70% VO₂max).
Mouse GSE126962/GSE132520: gastrocnemius/quadriceps treadmill responses at 3–4 h (60 min ramped and submaximal ramped protocols).
study_descriptions.Pattern B:
Human GSE71972/GSE87748: vastus lateralis after 60 min moderate unilateral knee extension (immediate) or 15 min at 80% VO₂max (4 h).
Mouse GSE97718: quadriceps 3 h after one maximal treadmill-to-exhaustion session.
